dr_digest

What a database file holds, as one 64-bit digest whatever its layout (DataReel 7.4).

Contents

Usage

Usage

dr_digest FILE [--kind btree|bytes|objects]

It prints one line, "HASH COUNT FILE": the hash as 16 hex digits, then the number of objects, keys or bytes it covers. The kinds:

  • objects: the live objects of a .gxd database file, so two files that hold the same objects give the same digest even when their free space, block order or addresses differ.
  • btree: the keys of a .btx B-tree index, in key order, whatever the shape of the tree.
  • bytes: the bytes of any file.

Without --kind it is btree for a .btx file and bytes for anything else. Exit 0 ok, 1 the file could not be read (the reason on standard error), 2 usage. From code, the same digest is gxDatabaseDigest() of gxddigest.h. It is the same as "gxrepl digest" of the 7.4 betas, so digests taken with either compare. Digests of vector indexes: vix_rebuild --digest.
